construction: eigh((A+A.T)/2), ascending; canonicalize each Q column so its largest-absolute component is positive; lambdas=geomspace(alpha,L,100); A_log=Q@diag(lambdas)@Q.T; no symmetrization of either optimization matrix
cache_policy: Within-update identity-point reuse: the exact same immutable argument array may reuse its gradient; cache is cleared before each update. No cross-update or cross-stage merging. B/RHGD's half-step and endpoint sites each cost one evaluation, even if they coincide at the floor. CAGD repeated calls on its same extrapolated argument reuse one gradient. Applied uniformly to every method.
rng: numpy.default_rng(method-specific integer seed); independent stream per path; same seed list on both spectra; CAGD pre-draws only num_updates+1 exponentials for this study
diagnostics: Two slow-only B paths using each matrix's ascending symmetric-part eigensystem, original signed projection amplitude; 200000 gradients each. Save all B states and pre-reset velocities. Save slow coordinate every update for all methods.
timing_horizon: full 200000 distinct gradients for all 26 primary paths; diagnostic controls excluded from timing/win counts
probe_paths: all 26 primary paths once, plus both slow-only diagnostics
representative_resets: first, middle and last B event with pre-update objective>1e-10, plus event immediately preceding the first sustained primary crossing if different; +/-3 updates
failure_policy: Retain partial arrays and charged work; no retry or drop; nonfinite state/objective/power is failure; failed paths cannot claim sustained success through the full budget; fail the study validation before performance interpretation if equivalence or provenance fails.

decision_rule.censoring: unreached is infinite cost, never discarded; if comparator is censored and B finite, use the comparator budget/time as a lower bound, and require a certified margin
